## Project Title ScreenQuest

## Background To display movies & a place where you can search & find a movie that could interest you.

## Key Features Write down clearly what are the things the user can perform with your web application. - Create Account - Login & Logout (not done) - Add, Update, Delete Movie - Search Movies - Add Ticket type - Search Ticket type (not done) - Create Playlist (not done) - Add Movie to playlist (not done) - Remove from playlist (not done) - View Playlists (not done) - Edit Profile (not done) - Change Password (not done) - Delete account (not done)

## External API(s) that you would like to use External APIs that I would use is a movie db API & I would use it for access & infomation of the movies. - https://developer.themoviedb.org/docs

- https://javascriptcentric.medium.com/30-node-js-modules-with-usecases-36950203722f
